tasks.corrected_reference_answer: CaseInsensitiveDict stores entries under lowercase keys and calls key.lower() on each get/delete (src/requests/structures.py:46-55). This adds work proportional to lookup-key length before usual dictionary lookup. Repeated lookups therefore have normalization overhead, but this source does not establish that it is significant or a bottleneck compared with HTTP I/O. Any cache optimization should be benchmarked and account for its memory/lookup overhead.

checked_claims.claim: Repeated Response.close calls never close raw twice
checked_claims.reason: close does not mark content consumed or track closure; unread repeated calls invoke raw.close again.

material_errors: close does not mark content consumed or track closure; unread repeated calls invoke raw.close again.
tasks.notes: Independent static inspection of pinned source; repository code was not executed. Scope is central claims, not exhaustive runtime verification.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Response context exit calls close. close invokes raw.close when _content_consumed is false and invokes release_conn when available (src/requests/models.py:1028-1039). Consumed content skips raw.close, but close itself does not change _content_consumed or set a closed flag. Repeated close on an unread response can therefore call raw.close repeatedly; safe repeated cleanup depends on the underlying object, not an explicit double-close guard here.
